(3) [Subtitle]: 地鐵4號出口直接出來 斜對角立刻抵達 自助辦理入住 簡單方便 房型非常非常多樣化 有預算考量的朋友 可以考慮合宿. (4) [Subtitle]: 男女分開 但同時也可以選擇 單人房或是雙人房 我自己則是一間. (5) [Subtitle]: 單人房大約 一個晚上3000元台幣左右 如果是合宿的話呢 最低一天 不用一千元. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a hotel recommendation vlog aimed at young solo travelers. The creator uses a first-person perspective and high-energy narration to highlight the affordability, cleanliness, and minimalist design of the Mangrove Dongdaemun hotel in Seoul. By showcasing specific storage solutions and common areas like the workspace and laundry, the video positions the hotel as a practical and stylish choice for short-term or medium-term stays.
